result.stdout:
Usage: polhem-db <command> [options] [--define <DefinePath>]

Commands:
  create                       Create the databases named in DatabaseSettings that do not exist, and the
                               master key file SystemSettings names when it is missing.
  check                        Open a connection to each database in DatabaseSettings.
  upgrade [--dry-run] [--allow-narrowing] [--table <name>]...
                               Build or upgrade the tables registered in DbCategorySettings.
  seed-admin --company <id> [options]
                               Create the first administrator, a company and the access between them.

Options:
  --define <DefinePath>        The definition folder (holds SystemSettings.xml). Default: the current directory.
  --help, -h                   Print this help text.
  --version                    Print the version.
